The mechanical aortic valve without anticoagulation raises concern for hemolysis and thrombotic complications. Advanced CKD predisposes to mineral‑bone disorder, though labs are missing. Alzheimer’s disease is established, with polypharmacy potentially worsening cognition. Infection remains low probability due to absent objective data.
